about: The data a waitlist site keeps. Everything the owner edits is data, so changes are instant.

fields.name: contact_email
fields.note: Optional. When empty, no Contact link is shown.

fields.name: accent
fields.note: A colour token chosen from the brief's look.

entities.name: Block
entities.note: One row per block on the page, in order.

fields.name: id
fields.note: hero, preview, benefits, waitlist, footer, or an extra block id

fields.name: content
fields.note: Validated per block type with Zod: headline, text, items, image references, button label.

entities.name: FormField
entities.note: The questions on the waitlist form. Email is always present and required.

fields.name: key
fields.note: Stable key used to store answers.

fields.name: answers
fields.note: Keyed by FormField key. Select values are stored as the option text at the time of signing up.

fields.name: source
fields.note: From a ?src= or utm_source parameter, else 'direct'. Max 60 characters.

fields.name: alt
fields.note: Owner-editable description. Never empty for a shown image.

entities.name: Owner
entities.note: Not stored. One owner from environment configuration: an email and a password hash.

rules: A Signup's email is unique. A second submission of the same email updates nothing and shows the same thank-you.
Option text in answers is stored as text, so renaming an option later does not change past answers.
Deleting a Signup removes it permanently. There is no soft delete in this version.
